label: FP
reason: The alert flags XSS on lines 92-97 which display the cookie name and value. However, the cookie name is derived entirely from the server-side class name and test number (hardcoded constants), and the cookie value is generated via SecureRandom (cryptographically secure random bytes). Neither contains user-supplied data, so there is no cross-site scripting vulnerability.

evidence.note: Both cookieName and rememberMeKey are constructed from server-side constants and SecureRandom, not user input
